risk_if_not_implemented: Without Control Assurance Automation (CAA) Aggregated Telemetry, automated control assurance results may be manipulated, misattributed or lose integrity, causing misplaced confidence in control effectiveness. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a Security Incident Event Manager (SIEM), or similar automated tool, to support the centralized collection of event logs and security-relevant telemetry.
compensating_control_1.justification: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry (MON-05) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) Aggregated Telemetry (DCH-41) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Correlate Monitoring Information
compensating_control_2.description: Automated mechanisms exist to correlate both technical and non-technical information from across the enterprise by a Security Incident Event Manager (SIEM) or similar automated tool, to enhance organization-wide situational awareness.
compensating_control_2.justification: Correlate Monitoring Information (MON-08) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) Aggregated Telemetry (DCH-41) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
